Checks 3-8 gated on a 201 first order; the never-placing variants score 1/8.
Learner pilot and Exa run-time measurement are platform/owner items; the README wording is conservative (4-7 s idle, 50-112 s loaded).
SKU definition and the plain-language rewrite are present at the landed bytes.
Resource rules are owner-set: the owner confirms the AI-off wording for allowedResources and the README (calendar S43/FT25 'Proctored Final: coding without AI').
Per-item weighting within aiOffCoding, tierA use and the S43 calendar formats vs the Final MCQ are programme/owner decisions.

Orchestrator decision: the pass mark stays 70% with unweighted checks. Evidence: in Spring 20 no wrong variant passes; in Spring 10 the passing single slips (N2, N5, X3, R1 at 4/5) are accepted as partial credit.
